subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — MarketGrid bakeoff & contract amendment
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@marketgrid.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + expected capacity increase

Hi Evelyn —

We’re approaching our renewal (Dec 1) and the product team wants to lock in capacity for a Q4 launch. Current usage has trended up ~2.6x this quarter; attached is a rolling usage extract and the 90-day spike profile.

High level asks from our side:
- Updated committed capacity pricing for a 3x uplift (baseline -> committed 3x).
- A short bakeoff plan so our infra team can validate latency percentiles at peak burst (we’ll be running in us-west).
- Confirmation of data retention / logging for audit (SOC2 evidence) and whether we can get a read-only access to request-level logs for the proof window.

We are also running a parallel POC with a third vendor (FluxAI) and expect a short bakeoff the week of 8/16. Would Redwood be available to run the same tests so we can compare end-to-end?

Attachment: marketgrid_usage_q3.csv (CSV)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, Product Ops | MarketGrid

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-05T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected capacity increase

Hi Alicia — thanks for the data. This is great context. Short answer: yes, we can run an apples-to-apples bakeoff and provide a scoped contract amendment for a committed 3x uplift.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood provides a bakeoff harness and a temporary, isolated test environment (us-west) — target: week of 8/16.
2) MarketGrid supplies a representative traffic replay (or the CSV you attached) + target SLA/latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99).
3) Redwood runs 3x runs (steady, burst, long-tail) and delivers raw percentiles + cost projection for steady-state and burst.
4) Post-bakeoff: Redwood will produce an amendment including committed capacity pricing and a phased rollout schedule (canary -> full).

I’ve looped in Naomi (solutions) to define the test matrix and Jordan for legal/ops questions. Karthik will own commercial terms. I’ll coordinate kickoff and look after timelines.

Attachment: redwood_map_marketgrid_v1.docx (MAP draft)

Are there any blackout windows for your infra team the week of 8/16?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-06T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected capacity increase

Alicia —

Thanks for sharing the CSV. For an accurate comparison we’ll need:
- A 10-minute sample of synthetic replay at peak QPS (if you can provide it as a tarball or point us to an S3 replay).
- Target latency SLAs (p50/p95/p99) you care about and an allowed error rate.
- Sample payloads (anonymized) to exercise the same prompt sizes/sequence lengths.

I’m attaching a suggested bakeoff matrix (what we’ll measure: latency percentiles, 99.9th token timeouts, memory/KV cache hit, cost per 1M tokens). We’ll spin up a sandbox cluster with the same model variants you’re evaluating and produce a short-run and a long-run.

Drive folder with scripts and a placeholder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketgrid-bakeoff

Attachment (referenced in Drive): bakeoff_matrix.md (plain text in Drive)

I’ll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff for 8/12 to align on the replay artifacts unless you prefer earlier.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@marketgrid.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected capacity increase

Thanks Naomi — we can do the replay. Two notes from procurement:
- We need a clean amendment (term + committed capacity) and a SOC2 excerpt before we start any shared testing. Can Redwood provide a short SOC2 summary and redacted audit page?
- FluxAI asked for the same windows; we’re trying to keep the tests identical. Objective: verify p99 under burst at 1.5M tokens / hr.

Procurement also wants to know whether Redwood will accept a 120-day termination clause for the committed uplift in case performance regressions surface during rollout. Can Karthik propose standard language?

Regards,
Alicia

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected capacity increase

Alicia — appreciate the clarity. We can provide: 
- A redactable SOC2 excerpt and a brief compliance pack for your legal team.
- A proposed amendment that includes a phased commitment (90 days canary at 50% of uplift, then ramp to 100% over 60 days). For termination language, we typically propose a 90-day performance remediation window with an option to terminate the uplift only after a documented failure to meet agreed SLAs; however, we can discuss a 120-day uplift-protection clause as a concession in enterprise deals.

Attached is an initial pricing sheet showing committed tier pricing and the uplift delta. Pricing assumes a 12-month committed term starting on renewal date.

Attachment: redwood_pricing_tiers_v3.pdf (PDF)

If that structure sounds reasonable I’ll draft the amendment and legal can loop in Jordan for the final language. For the bakeoff, Naomi’s team can stand up the environment; we just need the replay S3 path and IAM read access.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@marketgrid.com>

Karthik/Naomi —

We can give you a read-only S3 replay at s3://marketgrid-replays/bakeoff/2026-08 and a short list of sample payloads (already uploaded). Procurement has requested the SOC2 excerpt; I’ll share that in a separate email (redacted).

We’ll begin the vendor POCs on 8/16 — happy to align on windows for Redwood. Also sending a DocuSign link for an amendment placeholder so legal can start reviewing while the bakeoff runs: https://www.docusign.com/recipient-envelope?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

Please confirm the kickoff slot for 8/16 and Tech lead we should expect on the call.

— Alicia

Alicia — confirmed. 8/16 kickoff at 09:00 PT (30 minutes). Naomi will lead the technical runbook; Karthik will join for commercial questions; Jordan will be on hand for legal/POC terms.

Quick summary / owners: 
- Naomi: bakeoff harness + sandbox cluster (deliverables: short-run and long-run results; raw logs).
- MarketGrid: S3 replay + sample payloads + SOC2 redacted excerpt.
- Karthik: draft amendment (90-day canary / proposed 120-day termination concession).
- Evelyn: coordinate schedule and exec summary at the end of bakeoff.

We’ll produce an interim results deck within 48 hours of the long-run completion and an amendment draft within 7 business days of kickoff. If anything changes before 8/16 ping me directly.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.
